scientific_question: Is the terminal c_proj residual-write direction predictably encoded by the same expert's learned c_fc feature frame, or does c_proj require an independent downstream-error/output frame?

theory.mlp_unit: y(x)=sum_j b_j GELU(a_j^T x), with c_fc feature a_j and c_proj write b_j.
theory.write_gradient: grad_b_j L = sum_t delta_t GELU(a_j^T x_t).
theory.feature_gradient: grad_a_j L = sum_t x_t GELU'(a_j^T x_t) (b_j^T delta_t).
theory.nonidentifiability: The write update observes the full residual-error vector delta_t, whereas the feature update observes only its scalar projection through b_j. Holding x,a,b fixed while changing error components orthogonal to b changes grad_b without changing grad_a. A feature-only write decoder is therefore not generally identifiable.
theory.norm_correlation_scope: Prior c_fc-row/c_proj-column norm correlation can measure shared neuron use or scale. It does not establish vector-direction predictability.
theory.empirical_discriminator: Give the feature-only hypothesis a maximally favorable dense linear upper bound, fit on 1280 hidden neurons and score 256 unseen neurons per expert. Scored neurons may fit only radial coefficients after their direction is predicted.
theory.relation_to_prior_failures: Stable paired-neuron assignment, 2.4-5.3 percent pairing-aware temporal recovery, failed shared hidden gain, failed KFAC/task-gradient images, and one-third Kronecker functional recovery all motivate testing direction predictability directly rather than another training arm.

target.matrix: terminal c_proj minus same-run step-zero c_proj, one 768x1536 matrix per expert
target.gauge: native same-run hidden identity; prior functional audit found about 98 percent native identity and stable heldout assignment

neuron_protocol.anti_leakage: Every shared orientation is fit only on the 1280 fit neurons. The 256 scored neurons may fit one or two scalar radial coefficients but cannot change the predicted shared direction.

tied_current_motion_plane.equation: predicted Delta b_j = rho0_j a_terminal_j + rho1_j Delta a_j

dense_current_ridge.equation: predicted direction = R a_terminal_j, followed by one oracle radial coefficient
dense_current_ridge.role: non-compression-valid dense linear direction upper bound

dense_current_motion_ridge.equation: predicted direction = R0 a_terminal_j + R1 Delta a_j, followed by one oracle radial coefficient
dense_current_motion_ridge.role: maximally favorable non-compression-valid feature-only linear upper bound and binding gate

fit.solver: batched closed-form ridge; primal when features <= fit neurons and dual otherwise
fit.feature_normalization: normalize current and motion vectors separately per hidden neuron
fit.score_radial: least-squares scalar on the already-predicted direction; this deliberately favors feature-only representability
fit.diagnostic: record fit recovery and effective regularized condition number so numerical underfit cannot be mistaken for scientific rejection

functional_protocol.activation_state: same-run terminal model, router, and c_fc
functional_protocol.primary_metric: Exact routed residual-write recovery contributed by the 256 unseen neurons, on both untouched token frames.
secondary_metrics: per-layer, per-seed, per-partition, and per-token-frame recovery

decision_rule.pass: Only if the dense current-plus-motion upper bound passes all gates may a separately preregistered compact shared-orientation map be tested. A pass does not authorize training, MFU, generated experts, or a larger rung.
decision_rule.fail: Reject feature-only linear write-direction prediction. Do not launch tied, diagonal, Householder, Cayley, or feature-derived c_proj training. The next latent function must carry an independent task-conditioned output/error directional stream and count its state explicitly.
decision_rule.scope: A failure does not prove that no arbitrarily large nonlinear hypernetwork can infer writes from features. It rejects the scientifically relevant shared linear/orthogonal relation even under a dense decoder upper bound; a larger learned nonlinear decoder would violate the intended 200-500x state budget unless separately justified.

execution.policy: Run a no-scientific-value synthetic/test preflight first. Foreground-poll only if measured ETA is under five minutes; otherwise launch a persistent terminal/error watchdog with an event-specific @Codex callback.
